articles.summary: 2024 was a turning point as BaaS programs unraveled, new rules under the GENIUS Act took shape, and the Synapse fallout made direct oversight of every account and transaction essential. In 2025, Treasury Prime used its BankOS platform and bank network to help banks and fintechs move from firefighting to safe, auditable embedded programs. This recap explains what we built, how we showed up in the industry, and what it means for 2026 planning.
articles.title: Treasury Prime’s 2025 Year in Review: Rebuilding trust and scale in embedded banking

articles.summary: Treasury Prime is the operating platform for banks in the fintech era. A multi-bank network: 20+ banks, $1.1T in combined assets, 4 million active accounts.
articles.title: Treasury Prime Launches AI Marketplace to Transform Bank-Fintech Partnerships
